visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a female patient lying on a beige treatment bed with her eyes closed. She is wearing a white T-shirt with the black text 'MARITHÉ FRANÇOIS GIRBAUD' and 'PARIS' printed on it. Above her, a hand in a black sleeve holds a white and orange medical device towards her forehead. The background is a clean clinic setting with bright, even studio lighting. (2) The scene becomes more complex as multiple practitioners' hands enter the frame, each wielding different skincare devices like the 'SCITON' laser probe and various white acoustic wave applicators. The devices are positioned simultaneously over different parts of her face. Several text callouts in Traditional Chinese appear around the probes, labeling the specific laser and facial treatments being performed. (3) The visual transitions to a minimalist white outro screen. The top features the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo in black. Below it, technical contact information is listed, including a LINE handle, a phone number, and two physical clinic addresses. The lighting remains bright and clinical, emphasizing a professional and clean brand identity.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with four sharp, rapid-fire camera shutter sound effects (SFX) that simulate a photography session. Simultaneously, a high-tempo electronic synthesizer melody enters with a bright, energetic tone. There are no vocals at this stage, focusing on the mechanical clicks and the emerging pop beat. (2) A rhythmic pop-rap song featuring a solo female vocalist begins. She delivers lyrics with an animated, confident tone and a moderate pitch level. The BGM consists of heavy electronic drum hits and a pulsing synthesizer bassline at 124 BPM. The vocal clarity is high, and the mix is clean with no ambient interference, emphasizing the catchy commercial nature of the track. (3) The pop track continues consistently as the vocals move through a verse. The beat remains strong and percussive with prominent synthesized textures. There is no shift in tempo or vocal intensity as the audio continues through the outro, eventually ending with a clean hard cut that aligns with the end of the video duration.
